proves.claim: sameWorkHeads returns a cited head A when the submitted head is A plus a merge of main that left the item files and cited test files identical.

cli.io-verify-merge-ticks.a-merge-of-mai.why: Without it a check-less accept refuses CLAUSE_UNTICKED for work a merge of main did not change.

proves.claim: sameWorkHeads returns none when the merge changed an item file or cited test file, the cited commit is not an ancestor, or no files are recorded.

cli.io-verify-merge-ticks.a-changed-file.why: Without it a tick could vouch for work that changed after it ran.
